_comment: USD per million tokens, Anthropic first-party list prices. Applied at query time: each request is priced
with the entry in force at its timestamp ('from' is an inclusive ISO date; null = since the beginning).
To change a price, append a new entry with a 'from' date; never edit an old one.
verified: claude-code = matched Claude Code's own cost figure to the cent (design.md section 3);
docs = published price list (claude-api skill, cached 2026-09-25); assumed = standard multipliers
(cache read 0.1x input, 5m write 1.25x, 1h write 2x), check against https://www.anthropic.com/pricing.
fast_multiplier is unverified: no fast-mode request has been observed yet.
Cache-read rates that look odd but are as published: claude-fable-5-1 $0.25 ('0.025x, a quarter of
Claude Fable 5's'), claude-fable-5 $1.00, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 $0.20.
